messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: paging oncall-sre — Elevated p99 streaming latency and increased streaming stalls in eu-west-2. Trigger: p99 > 2s for 5m. Details: https://telemetry.redwood/alerts/1849998888
oncall-sre: acked. I'm live. Kofi/Net, Priya — can you join?
Jules H.: looking at streaming tail metrics. p95 jumped from ~300ms to 1.1s, p99 ~2.4s. Spike started ~10:12 UTC. Any ACLs or deploys?
Kofi N.: not seeing product deploys. Net: checking egress distribution and NATs.
Priya (net): noticing a big imbalance: azc outbound NAT usage skyrocketed. nat-azc-11 ephemeral_ports=92%. Other AZ NATs at ~30-40%. Also seeing ~150ms DNS delays from azc resolver.
infra-bot: autoscaler event: created nat-azc-11 at 10:11:58 UTC and replaced route table entry for subnet-200.
Sam T.: logs show many streaming sessions reporting TLS handshake timeouts and subsequent reconnects. Example:
```
stream-proxy | 2026-04-02T10:12:45Z | session=ztl TLS handshake timeout
streaming-svc | 2026-04-02T10:12:50Z | upstream read timeout, conn reset
```

Jules H.: that fits. If one AZ got the bulk of egress, ephemeral exhaustion explains handshake failures.
Kofi N.: digging into route history: replace-route to nat-azc-11 at 10:11:59 by autoscaler job id asg-route-sync-73. Looks like route replaced before new NAT fully registered, causing traffic surge.
Priya (net): confirmed, nat-azc-11 conntrack table peaked and started rejecting new mappings. DNS resolver queue for azc spiked due to retransmits.
oncall-sre: immediate mitigation options? suggestions: 1) failover streaming subnets in azc to nat-azb-02, 2) bring a second nat in azc, 3) bump conntrack timers temporarily.
Sam T.: prefer quick reroute to reduce customer impact. I'll hold on launching config changes until reroute is live.
Priya (net): executing runbook 'egress-shift' for only streaming subnets. Command: `aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-stream-azc --nat-gateway-id nat-azb-02`
infra-bot: runbook started by Priya (net). Link: https://runbooks.redwood/egress-shift
Priya (net): route replace issued. Monitoring ingest.
Kofi N.: ephemeral usage dropping on nat-azc-11: 92% -> 48% within 90s. conntrack frees increasing. DNS latency returning to ~25ms.
Jules H.: p95 -> 260ms, p99 -> 610ms. Streaming stalls decreasing. Good.
cs-ops: any customer impact? we have an inbound note from VoiceStream that they saw audio blips ~10:12-10:18 UTC.
noncall-sre: customer impact: minimal but noticeable for a few tenants during the 6-minute window. Recommend proactive note to affected CS contacts.
Sam T.: spinning up nat-azc-12 as hot spare (ami=nat-optimized, instance-type=c6i.large). Expected ready in 2m.
infra-bot: nat-azc-12 provisioning started.
Priya (net): after stabilizing I'll propose alerting for ephemeral_ports_pct>70 with an automated reroute play. Also suggest gating route replacements until NAT health checks pass.
Kofi N.: found a small route-propagation race: autoscaler replaced route as instance came online but before ENI NAT attachments registered fully; traffic briefly concentrated. Need to patch asg-route-sync to wait for `DescribeNatGateway` health state.
Jules H.: collecting traces and uploading pcaps: s3://incidents/1849998888/trace.tar.gz.
cs-ops: drafting customer message: "We experienced a brief increase in streaming latency and reconnects in eu-west-2 between 10:12 and 10:18 UTC due to an egress routing event and NAT capacity pressure. We've applied mitigations and are investigating; follow-up RCA to follow." Who sends?
noncall-sre: please post to #support and notify the affected accounts. Sam, can you own customer comms?
Sam T.: yes, I'll post status and include the incident link.
Priya (net): proposed follow-ups: 1) add ephemeral port usage alert and auto-reroute, 2) change autoscaler route logic to wait for NAT readiness, 3) add synthetic TLS handshake SLO tests per-AZ, 4) tune conntrack defaults and monitor.
Kofi N.: adding to incident ticket INC-2026-1849 and assigning owners.
oncall-sre: handoff: I'm available for 15 more minutes then handing to Jules for RCA lead. Jules, you taking at 10:40?
Jules H.: taking handoff at 10:40 and will produce draft postmortem in 72h. Will include timeline, route-change diff, autoscaler logs, and customer impact.
infra-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1849 — https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-1849
Priya (net): marking live mitigation complete. Current p99 ~590ms, errors baseline.
noncall-sre: thanks team. Keep any follow-up artifacts in the ticket and assign owners. If repeats occur, escalate to platform networking for routing orchestration changes.
Sam T.: customer note posted and CS notified.
summary: Live mitigation for eu-west-2 streaming p95/p99 spike caused by autoscaler-induced route replacement that concentrated egress on a new NAT, leading to ephemeral port exhaustion and DNS queueing. Quick reroute and NAT provisioning mitigated impact; RCA and runbook changes assigned.
